name: APPLES
overview: A tavern exists at the intersection of time and space, the Back Alley of Guyu Street. Come, wander through the maze of the real world. Here, time never runs out. Order a dream and encounter strangers. And see Mo, a mellow boy with a capybara's soul, as he strips away fixations to uncover, deep in the haze of nightmares, a barely visible glimpse of "we."
